--- title: "Part 5: Diagnostics & Reporting" subtitle: "Lab 4: Linear Models" format: html filters: - webr webr: packages: ['readr'] show-startup-message: false --- ::: {.cell} ::: ```{webr-r} #| context: setup #| warning: false #| message: false library(readr) data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LittleMonkeyLab/datarepo/main/regression_data.csv" wellbeing <- read_csv(data_url, show_col_types = FALSE) ``` ## Watch the Demo Follow along with the slides below. ```{=html} ``` ::: {.callout-tip} ## Tip Click inside the slide area first, then use arrow keys to navigate. ::: --- ## Try It Yourself ::: {.callout-tip} ## How to Practice 1. **Run the diagnostic plots** and check each one 2. **Run the normality test** and interpret the result 3. **Copy to RStudio** for your notebook exercises ::: ### Diagnostic Plots ```{webr-r} model <- lm(wellbeing ~ stress + sleep_hours + exercise_mins, data = wellbeing) par(mfrow = c(2, 2)) plot(model) ``` ::: {.callout-note} ## What to Look For - **Residuals vs Fitted**: Random scatter — no pattern = linearity OK - **Normal Q-Q**: Points follow the diagonal line = normality OK - **Scale-Location**: Horizontal band = homoscedasticity OK - **Residuals vs Leverage**: No extreme outliers = no influential cases ::: ### Test Normality of Residuals ```{webr-r} model <- lm(wellbeing ~ stress + sleep_hours + exercise_mins, data = wellbeing) result <- shapiro.test(residuals(model)) cat("Shapiro-Wilk test of residuals:\n") cat("W =", round(result$statistic, 3), "\n") cat("p =", round(result$p.value, 3), "\n\n") cat("Interpretation:", ifelse(result$p.value > 0.05, "Residuals do not significantly depart from normality (p > .05).", "Residuals may not be normally distributed (p < .05).")) ``` ### Generate APA Output ```{webr-r} model <- lm(wellbeing ~ stress + sleep_hours + exercise_mins, data = wellbeing) s <- summary(model) f_p <- pf(s$fstatistic[1], s$fstatistic[2], s$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE) f_text <- if (f_p < 0.001) "p < .001" else paste0("p = ", round(f_p, 3)) cat("=== APA REPORTING VALUES ===\n\n") cat("Overall model:\n") cat(" R² = ", round(s$r.squared, 2), ", Adjusted R² = ", round(s$adj.r.squared, 2), "\n", sep = "") cat(" F(", s$fstatistic[2], ", ", s$fstatistic[3], ") = ", round(s$fstatistic[1], 2), ", ", f_text, "\n\n", sep = "") cat("Individual predictors:\n") for (i in 2:4) { name <- c("Stress", "Sleep", "Exercise")[i - 1] b <- round(s$coefficients[i, 1], 2) se <- round(s$coefficients[i, 2], 2) p <- s$coefficients[i, 4] p_text <- if (p < 0.001) "p < .001" else paste0("p = ", round(p, 3)) cat(" ", name, ": b = ", b, ", SE = ", se, ", ", p_text, "\n", sep = "") } ``` --- ## Self-Assessment ::: {.webex-check .webex-box} **1.
